name: dlfs_read
description: Read file contents from a DLFS drive. Returns text content with UTF-8 encoding for text files, or base64-encoded content for binary files. Also returns the file size in bytes.

drive.description: Drive name, or a DID-URL reference to another user's drive (e.g. 'did:key:zOwner.../drive')

ucans.description: Optional UCAN JWT proofs authorising delegated access to another user's drive
